app.name: Free Exercise Book
home.title: Welcome
home.subtitle: Study offline. Practise daily. Revise your mistakes.
library.title: Library
status.ai_note: Not yet checked by a human reviewer. Please report anything that looks wrong.
topic.fallback: This topic is not available in the selected language yet. Showing English.
q.wrong: Not quite. The correct answer is {label}.
q.keys: Keys: 1–4 or A–D to choose, Enter to check and continue
q.fallback: Shown in English (translation not ready yet)
summary.title: Session complete
revise.title: Revise
revise.empty: Nothing to revise yet. Questions you answer wrongly will appear here until you get them right.
settings.title: Settings
settings.about_text: Free and open source (GPL-3.0). Content: CC BY-SA 4.0. Works offline. No account, no tracking.
settings.language_help: Notes and questions are shown in this language. Menus stay in English.
downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.subtitle: Download topics once and study them offline. Each topic is a small, verified pack.
downloads.import_title: Choose a folder with content packs (manifest.json)
downloads.remove_confirm: Remove “{title}”? Your practice history for it is kept, and you can download it again later.
downloads.offline: Couldn't reach the content server. You can still use installed topics and import packs from a folder.
downloads.empty_installed: No topics installed yet. Download some below.
downloads.dev_mode: Developer mode (FEB_CONTENT_DIR is set): content is loaded directly from a folder and packs are disabled.
downloads.nothing_new: Nothing new to install from that folder.
tests.title: Tests
tests.subtitle: Timed mock tests with negative marking, like the real exam.
tests.discard_confirm: Discard “{title}”? Your answers in it will be lost.
tests.patterns_help: Uses the exam's sections, marks and negative marking. If you haven't downloaded enough topics, the test is shortened and the time scaled to match.
tests.available: {a} of {q} questions available from your topics
tests.none_available: Download topics for this exam's subjects first.
tests.custom_help: Choose topics, number of questions, time and marking.
tests.no_patterns: No exam patterns installed yet. They come with content packs (Downloads).
new.title: Custom test
new.name: Name (optional)
new.count_help: {n} questions available in the selected topics. Unseen questions come first, then ones you got wrong.
new.no_topics: No topics installed. Download topics first.
ins.title: Instructions
ins.scaled: This test was shortened from {q} questions / {min} minutes to match the topics you have installed. Time was scaled in proportion.
ins.missing: {n} question(s) were removed from your content since this test was created and are skipped.
ins.rule1: The timer starts when you press Start. The test submits itself when time runs out.
ins.rule2: Answers are saved as you go. If you close the app, you can resume later; the timer pauses while you're away.
ins.rule3: Use “Mark for review” to come back to a question. Marked questions with an answer are graded.
ins.rule4: Answers and explanations are shown after you submit.
run.question: Question {i} of {n}
run.pause_confirm: Pause and exit? The timer stops and you can resume from the Tests page.
run.time_up: Time is up. Submitting your test…
run.keys: 1–4 / A–D choose · ← → move · M mark · Ctrl+Enter submit
res.title: Result
res.col.name: Name
rev.title: Review
search.placeholder: Search notes and questions, or type a command…
search.label: Search
search.hint: Search works in the selected content language, plus English terms. Tip: Bengali and English digits both work (1857 / ১৮৫৭).
search.keys: ↑ ↓ to move · Enter to open · Esc to close
srs.wrong_note: This question comes back in {t} for another try.
revise.due_help: Questions you got wrong come back here at growing intervals (spaced repetition). Grade how well you remembered each one.
revise.due_empty: Nothing due right now. Wrong answers in practice and tests are scheduled here automatically.
revise.mistakes_help: Questions whose latest answer was wrong, until you get them right.
progress.title: Progress
progress.subtitle: Your activity and accuracy. Everything stays on this computer.
progress.accuracy_help: Latest answer to each question you've tried
progress.weak_help: Topics where fewer than 60% of your latest answers are right.
progress.weak_none: No weak topics. Keep practising to keep it that way.
progress.empty: Practise a topic or take a test, and your progress shows up here.
settings.goal_help: Questions to answer each day (practice, tests and revision all count).
ca.title: Current Affairs
ca.subtitle: Monthly news digests for exams, with sources. Download months from Downloads.
ca.verify_note: Each item links to its official source. Facts can change after the “as of” date.
ob.welcome.title: Welcome to Free Exercise Book
ob.welcome.text: Free practice for Indian government exams: notes, MCQs, mock tests, revision and current affairs.
ob.welcome.p1: Works offline. Download topics once and study anywhere.
ob.welcome.p2: Study content in English or বাংলা (Bengali).
ob.welcome.p3: Free and open source. No account, no ads, no tracking.
ob.lang.title: Which language do you want to study in?
ob.lang.text: Notes and questions are shown in this language. Menus stay in English. You can switch any time with the language button (Ctrl+L).
ob.exams.title: Which exams are you preparing for?
ob.exams.text: Choose one or more. We use this to suggest topics and show your exam's mock tests first.
ob.goal.title: Set a daily goal
ob.goal.text: How many questions do you want to answer each day? Practice, tests and revision all count.
ob.topics.title: Choose topics to download
ob.topics.text: Topics included with the app are already installed. Pick more from the content server, or skip and use Downloads later.
ob.topics.offline: Couldn't reach the content server. You can download topics later from Downloads.
ob.topics.none: Nothing more to download right now.
ob.done.title: You're all set
ob.done.text: Start with a topic in the Library, or take a mock test. Press Ctrl+K (⌘K on Mac) anytime to search.
settings.exams_help: Used to suggest topics and to show your exams' mock tests first.
data.title: Your data
data.help: Your progress (answers, tests, revision schedule and settings) is stored only on this computer. Back it up or move it to another computer with a backup file.
data.import_confirm: Replace your current progress with this backup?\n\nYour current progress is saved first, so you can undo this by importing that copy.
data.imported: Progress restored: {a} answers, {t} tests, {c} review cards. Your previous progress was saved to {path}
data.reset_confirm: Delete all your answers, test results and revision schedule? Settings and downloaded topics are kept. This cannot be undone; export a backup first if you might need it.
